cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. Quality Assurance Engineers are responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of cloud-native AI diagnostics applications. As a global team, we celebrate diversity and believe that effective communication across cultures enhances our creativity and productivity.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Bring your expertise in deep exploratory testing to uncover nuanced issues beyond conventional testing boundaries.
Reviews and validates requirements and technical specifications
Develops and executes detailed test cases based on requirements and/or customer feedback and prioritization
Documents results; offer observations or improvements after analysis of test results and overall product quality
Works closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and product owners to understand requirements, provide input during design and development, and ensure quality throughout the software development life cycle
Manages testing efforts across varied projects and tasks under tight deadlines
Continuously improves. Identifying opportunities for process improvements
Willing to overlap with CET (Central European Time) when required
Other duties as assigned
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 2+ years of quality assurance experience in Agile Development environments
Must know Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Knows quality assurance methodologies, standards, and best practices.
Experience with web-based application testing
Experience with integration testing between applications
Excellent communication skills to convey testing strategies, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders with the ability to navigate and bridge cultural differences
Preferred Requirements
Experience in conducting deep exploratory testing to identify potential issues, vulnerabilities, and areas for improvement not covered by standard testing procedures.
Strong process-oriented mindset.
Ability to assess and manage risks associated with software quality and make informed decisions.
Commitment to continuous improvement, staying current with industry trends, and incorporating best practices into QA processes.

Bring your expertise in deep exploratory testing to uncover nuanced issues beyond conventional testing boundaries.
Reviews and validates requirements and technical specifications
Develops and executes detailed test cases based on requirements and/or customer feedback and prioritization
Documents results; offer observations or improvements after analysis of test results and overall product quality
Works closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and product owners to understand requirements, provide input during design and development, and ensure quality throughout the software development life cycle
Manages testing efforts across varied projects and tasks under tight deadlines
Continuously improves. Identifying opportunities for process improvements
Willing to overlap with CET (Central European Time) when required
Other duties as assigned
cond_0013.requirements:

At least 2+ years of quality assurance experience in Agile Development environments
Experience in conducting deep exploratory testing to identify potential issues, vulnerabilities, and areas for improvement not covered by standard testing procedures.
Experience with web-based application testing
Experience with integration testing between applications
Must know Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Knows quality assurance methodologies, standards, and best practices.
Excellent communication skills to convey testing strategies, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders with the ability to navigate and bridge cultural differences
Strong process-oriented mindset.
Ability to assess and manage risks associated with software quality and make informed decisions.
Commitment to continuous improvement, staying current with industry trends, and incorporating best practices into QA processes.

cond_0241.responsibilities:
Apply deep exploratory testing to uncover issues beyond conventional testing boundaries.
Review and validate requirements and technical specifications.
Develop and execute detailed test cases based on requirements and/or customer feedback and prioritization.
Document results; provide observations or improvement notes following analysis of test results and overall product quality.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and product owners, to understand requirements, provide input during design and development, and support quality throughout the software development life cycle.
Manage testing efforts across varied projects and tasks under tight deadlines.
Identify opportunities for process improvements on an ongoing basis.
Overlap with CET (Central European Time) when required.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0241.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 2 years of quality assurance experience in Agile Development environments.
Experience conducting deep exploratory testing to identify potential issues, vulnerabilities, and areas for improvement not covered by standard testing procedures.
Solid knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including QA methodologies, standards, and best practices.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting to convey testing strategies, results, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including across cultural differences.
Strong process-oriented mindset.
Preferred Requirements:
Experience with web-based application testing.
Experience with integration testing between applications.
Ability to assess and manage risks associated with software quality and make informed decisions.
Commitment to continuous improvement, staying current with industry trends, and incorporating best practices into QA processes.
